entries.title: Read the release notes again after closing them
entries.body: What’s New in the new Help menu opens the latest release note again, even after you closed it. Typing “what’s new” or “release notes” in command search (⌘K) does the same, and so does asking Firstmate. Settings → General shows the version you are running and lists every release note you were shown; choose one to read it again.

picture.alt: Settings → General with a Version row naming stable 0.1.28 and listing the four release notes it was shown, by version and date
